resources.string: Please give the profile a name.
Please choose the folder on the mobile.
Please choose at least one folder on the mobile.
Please turn on photos, videos or both.
Please enter the Share path, e.g. \\\\192.168.1.20\\Photos.
Profile “%1$s” already has the same target and the same sources.

A folder of this profile lies inside a folder of profile “%1$s” (or the other way round). The same files would be synced by both profiles – this can lead to duplicate copies, conflicts or unwanted deletions.
Same target as profile “%1$s” and shared source folders: %2$s. These files would be checked and transferred by both profiles.
Same target as profile “%1$s”. These files would be checked and transferred by both profiles.
What do you want to sync?
Photos and videos from the mobile to the PC. Stored by year, month and travel country, e.g. 2026\\06 - Egypt. Optionally remove them from the mobile afterwards.
Mirror any folder 1:1, with subfolders and all file types. Direction selectable: mobile → PC, PC → mobile or both ways.
